hero.subheadline: I turn complex business rules and disconnected data into reliable, repeatable processes across CRM, marketing, reporting, and operations.

experience.headline: From QA and software to data operations.

items.text: Designs reusable data processes and automation across Salesforce/Nimble AMS and connected marketing, membership, event, finance, and reporting systems. Supports CRM migration and reconciliation, translates business rules into SQL/SOQL logic, and develops reporting and data-quality monitoring used across the organization.
Built SQL and Python tools, ETL workflows, and applications for internal operations, reducing manual work and improving maintainability.

roles.text: Progressed from volunteer work to paid QA and live-operations support, testing releases, reproducing defects, and validating fixes. Documented findings developers could act on.
Tested game systems, reproduced technical issues, and documented defects with clear reproduction steps.
